dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 — Listed Building polygons
evidence_slice: Historic England's official Open Data Hub/NHLE metadata identifies Listed Building polygons as an official dataset and states that polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011. The metadata describes record fields including ListEntry, Name, Grade and area_ha, with area_ha populated where a building footprint has been mapped. Official NHLE List Entry 1239561 is Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter, Grade II, described as a pair of early-C19 detached villas, and records a most recent amendment date of 19 July 2016. A distinct exact layer-3 GeoJSON query for ListEntry 1239561 with returnGeometry=true and outSR=4326 was selected, but the response payload was not retrievable through the available web channel and direct network DNS resolution failed. No polygon geometry was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official NHLE polygon metadata states area_ha is populated where a building footprint has been mapped, but the exact layer-3 GeoJSON response for ListEntry 1239561 was inaccessible; no Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates were read.
